post.x-ms-description-for-model: Use tool to upload, save, or create a file or documents in a SharePoint site. Example intent: "Save this report to SharePoint".
post.description: Uploads a file to a SharePoint site. Make sure to pick an existing library.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to the full HTTPS URL of the SharePoint site that contains the target document library, not the library URL. Example: https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/PMO

parameters.name: folderPath
parameters.description: Must start with an existing library. Add folders if needed.
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to library and folder path starting with the library name, followed by subfolders. Don't include site URL. Examples: Shared Documents, Documents/Reports/Monthly.

parameters.name: name
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set this to the file name including extension. Use name user specifies or a descriptive name that matches the content if not specified. Examples: invoice-1042.pdf, project-status.csv.

parameters.name: body
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to the file content as a binary value.

get.x-ms-description-for-model: Use this tool to list, browse, or enumerate the files and subfolders contained inside a specified SharePoint folder. Returns each entry's name, path, type, and identifier. Sample intent: 'List the files in the Project Plans folder'.
get.description: Returns files contained in a SharePoint folder.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to the full HTTPS URL of the SharePoint site that contains the target list, library, file, or folder. Do not include any list or library path. Example: https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/PMO.

get.description: Gets information about the folder. Uses a folder path to pick the folder.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to the full HTTPS URL of the SharePoint site that contains the target list, library, file, or folder. Do not include any list or library path. Example: https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/PMO.

parameters.name: path
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to the site-relative path of the folder inside the site. Example: /Shared Documents/Reports.

post.x-ms-description-for-model: Use this tool to create, add, or provision a new folder (or nested folder path) inside a SharePoint document library. Sample intents: 'Create a folder called Q1 Reports in Documents'; 'Create the folder path Projects/2025/Contoso'.
post.description: Creates a new folder or folder path.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to the full HTTPS URL of the SharePoint site that contains the target list, library, file, or folder. Do not include any list or library path. Example: https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/PMO.

parameters.name: table
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to the exact display name (or library GUID) of the SharePoint document library. Example: Documents.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: Parameters to this operation passed in the body.
parameters.x-ms-summary: Parameters to this operation passed in the body
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to a JSON object with `path` set to the new folder path. The path may be a single folder name (e.g. '2026 Reports') or a nested path that creates the full folder chain (e.g. 'folder1/folder2/folder3').

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Avoid column threshold issues by only using columns defined in a view.
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Usually leave empty. Set to a SharePoint list view name (or view GUID) only when the user mentions a specific view, or to avoid list view threshold errors on large lists.

post.x-ms-description-for-model: Use this tool when the user wants to add, create, post, record, log, submit, track, register, file, or report a new item in a SharePoint list. Sample intents: 'Log Sarah's vacation request from March 1-5 2025', 'Create IT ticket for James - printer not working, assign to help desk'
post.description: Creates a new item in a SharePoint list.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to the full HTTPS site URL of the SharePoint site that contains the target list, not the list URL. Example: https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/PMO.

parameters.name: table
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to the name of the SharePoint list where the item should be created. Based on the user's request or existing context, select the relevant list from possible options. Example: Tasks, Expenses.

parameters.name: item
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Set to a JSON object that maps column names from the list to values from the user or context. Use structured key value pairs, not plain text. You must include required fields and include non-required fields only if they can be inferred from user's request. Do not invent fields. Example: { Title: 'Call customer', DueDate: '2025-11-30', Status: 'Not Started' }.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Avoid column threshold issues by only using columns defined in a view
parameters.x-ms-description-for-model: Usually leave this empty. Set to a view name or GUID when the user mentions a specific view or when column threshold limits are a concern, so only columns from that view are used. Do NOT include a view if user's request does not mention a specific view. Example: FinanceView.
